description: Cockpit for a calendar month: for each outpost the month-to-date sales (VAT included, from the Vendooly data-hub), the month target, the end-of-month projection, Ads ACoS/TACoS, open findings (stock-outs, blocked listings, Ads on out-of-stock items) and a traffic light rosso/giallo/grigio/verde with reasons and the next action (rules 2026-10-15). Without cockpit_id uses the first active cockpit, or all visible outposts if none exists. include_health=true also reads Account Health live (one Amazon report per outpost: slower); without it health counts as UNKNOWN (yellow). Only ACTIVE marketplaces are listed (>= 10 units sold+pending in the last 30 days, from the data-hub); inactive ones are counted in dormant_summary. Always state the period and that amounts are VAT included.

include_dormant.description: Include also dormant marketplaces (< 10 units in the last 30 days); default: hidden and counted in dormant_summary.

name: get_cockpit
